admission.title: Live admission decision: {hospital}
admission.sub: Patient: Suresh Sharma ({age}) · coronary angioplasty · sum insured {si} · room-rent limit {limit} a day. A room {diff} a day dearer costs the family {saving}.
admission.impactBody: Taking the {rent} room removes the proportionate cut on {base} of room-priced charges: surgeon, cath lab, nursing and doctor visits.
admission.noteCut: Surgeon, cath lab, nursing and doctor visits cost more in this room, and the insurer pays them only in the ratio {limit} ÷ {rent}.
admission.notePick: Same surgeon, same stent, same care. Only the room changes.
admission.circular2020Body: Proportionate deductions only on charges priced by room; never on medicines, implants or diagnostics.
admission.deskLine: कृपया {rent} प्रतिदिन वाला कमरा दीजिए। हमारी पॉलिसी में कमरे की सीमा {limit} प्रतिदिन है, उससे महँगे कमरे में डॉक्टर और ऑपरेशन के खर्च भी कटेंगे।
admission.deskGloss: “Please give us the {rent}-a-day room. Our policy’s room limit is {limit} a day; in a dearer room the doctor and operation charges are cut too.”

rulesNames.R-HL-001: Proportionate deduction only on room-priced heads
rulesNames.R-HL-008: Room rent capped at the limit
rulesNames.R-HL-009: Super top-up pays only above its deductible

moments.title: The three moments where Indian families lose lakhs
moments.intro: Kavach learns the household once, in about two minutes. Then it acts before you need the hospital, at admission, and when the settlement letter arrives.

change.title: When life changes
change.featureBody: The request to move the group cover to a personal policy, drafted before the last working day (rule R-MG-001).

hospital.title: At the hospital desk
hospital.featureBody: Reads the estimate photo: which charges change with the room, and which card to give first.

claim.title: When a claim goes wrong
claim.body: The bill was <bill></bill>; the insurer approved <approved></approved> and cut <cut></cut> as a proportionate deduction, though the room was within the limit.
claim.featureBody: Each deduction checked against the policy wording; the appeal drafted for you to send yourself.

elder.title: Elder-friendly WhatsApp and voice
elder.body: At the desk, Kamala doesn’t open a website. She sends a Hindi voice note or a photo of the estimate on WhatsApp, and Kavach replies with a voice note and a card.
elder.f1Body: Speak or type in either language; the answer comes back the same way.
elder.f2Body: When Kamala gets an answer at the desk, Rahul gets a family alert on his phone.
elder.f3Title: Try it on the test number
elder.f3Body: Scan the code or open WhatsApp, then send RAHUL to join the demo family.
elder.caption: Meanwhile, on Rahul’s phone
elder.voiceText: अस्पताल वाले {rent} वाला डीलक्स कमरा लेने को कह रहे हैं। क्या लें?
elder.replyBody: सुरेश जी की पॉलिसी में कमरे की सीमा {limit} प्रतिदिन है। डीलक्स कमरे में डॉक्टर और ऑपरेशन के खर्च से {cut} कट जाएँगे।
elder.replyCardBody: {rent} प्रतिदिन वाला कमरा। आपको लगभग {pay} देने होंगे।
elder.replyCardRule: नियम R-HL-001 · साइन करने से पहले TPA डेस्क से पक्का कर लीजिए।
elder.replyAlert: राहुल को परिवार अलर्ट भेजा गया
elder.alertPill: Kavach: “Suresh is at {hospital}. Kavach told the family to ask for the {rent} room.”
elder.inputHint: Message or hold the mic to speak

policies.title: {count} public policy wordings in the test set
policies.intro: The test set is real Indian health insurance wordings, filed with IRDAI or published by the insurer and identified by their UIN. Kavach’s reader is scored against labels a person checks against each PDF.
policies.fixtures: The latest run used recorded test answers, not the live model: it proves the pipeline works; it is not an accuracy score.
policies.checked: {checked} of {count} labels checked by a person
policies.notice: Kavach is not an insurer, broker or agent. It earns no commission and sells no policy. Insurer names belong to their owners.

promise.title: Every number shows its working
promise.body: Rupee amounts come from tested rules, never from a guess. Tap “Why these numbers?” to see the rule and the clause behind each one.

relations.mother: Kamala, 58 · opens Kavach at the desk

story.step1Body: In Hindi, on her own phone. Kavach already knows Suresh’s two policies.

story.step3Body: Only room-priced charges are cut in the pricier room. Kavach says which card to give first, and what to ask the desk.

decision.patient: Suresh, 62 · planned angioplasty · two policies in the family
decision.why: Suresh’s policy pays a room up to a limit. Above it, the insurer also cuts the surgeon, theatre and other room-priced charges in the same proportion.
decision.script: “Please book the standard room for my father, at {amount} a day or less.”
decision.firstCard: Give the parents’ policy card first; the other policy covers what is left.

decision.script: “Please admit my father to a Class B1 ward.”
decision.firstCard: Give the Shield plan card first; MediShield Life is part of it.
